vetSays.line: 🛡️ Giuseppe, Nazerke, Nikolai and Stan met them at the door — 4 put down. Giuseppe, Nazerke, Nikolai, Stan are hurt.
🛡️ Giuseppe, Ingrid, Hannah, Zoltan and Stan met them at the door — 5 put down. Giuseppe, Ingrid, Hannah, Zoltan are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hannah just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Dominic, Giuseppe, Nazerke, Ingrid and Nikolai met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Nazerke, Ingrid, Nikolai are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ingrid just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hannah just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Giuseppe just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Giuseppe, Nazerke, Hannah, Nikolai and Zoltan met them at the door — 2 put down, 3 driven off. Nazerke, Hannah, Nikolai, Zoltan are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
💬 Luis has been asking you about Cold-Blooded — what it does, what it goes with. Planning something.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Stan just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Nazerke, Ingrid, Nikolai, Zoltan and Stan met them at the door — 1 put down, 3 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Nazerke, Ingrid, Nikolai, Zoltan, Stan are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ursula just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ursula met them at the door — 1 put down.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ursula just put down The Reunion... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ursula met them at the door — 1 put down.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.

regDeaths.name: something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log
a red moon rising between the trees, breathing
the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still
a shadow moving wrong against the sun
a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong
the absence of sound, shaped like wings
two knobs on glass-still water, watching
the absence of sound, shaped like wings
